mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE increase signal monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, preceding recession and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of FEDFUNDS decline/UNRATE increase instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: New housing starts exceeding 500 thousand units signal strengthening consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 500, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, correlating with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive monthly INDPRO increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures prompting monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS increases indicate robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of HOUST/RSAFS simultaneous increase instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0) signals labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth rate < 0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
